CustomProperties.Name: HasActiveFilters
CustomProperties.Tooltip: True when ActiveFilterCount is greater than zero

CustomProperties.Name: OnAdvancedFilters
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Executes when advanced filters action is selected

CustomProperties.Name: OnClear
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Executes when clear filters action is selected

CustomProperties.Name: OnRefresh
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Executes when refresh action is selected

CustomProperties.Name: OnSearch
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Executes when search action is selected

CustomProperties.Name: SearchText
CustomProperties.Tooltip: Current search text shown in summary

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    cmp_FilterBar.ActiveFilterCount > 0,
    cmp_FilterBar.ActiveFilterCount & " active filter" & If(cmp_FilterBar.ActiveFilterCount = 1, "", "s"),
    "No active filters"
) &
If(
    cmp_FilterBar.TotalRows > 0,
    " · " & cmp_FilterBar.TotalRows & " rows",
    ""
)
